entities.summary: Nicholas Joel Perry is an American former professional football player who was a linebacker for seven seasons in the National Football League (NFL) with the Green Bay Packers. He played college football for the USC Trojans. Perry was selected by the Packers in the first round of the 2012 NFL draft.
